prior_sanitized_evidence.causal_conclusion: Prompt-only JSON encoding hardening produced the identical three-attempt parse failure twice. The proven blocker is the nested JSON-inside-string representation for hidden reference transport in the FACT/INTENT/OBJ/NEXT authoring load, not candidate behavior or construct semantics.

authoring_remediation.representation_change: The existing string field carries a deterministic tagged record rather than nested JSON. The outer r6 AUTHOR_SCHEMA, field count, field names, types and cardinality remain unchanged.
tagged_record_contract: Exactly 13 non-empty lines in the fixed order below.
HF=NONE or comma-separated frozen critical hard-fail identifiers
authoring_remediation.decoder_rule: Evaluator accepts only the exact 13-line tag/order contract, validates non-empty values, validates HF against the frozen hard-fail enum, and deterministically reconstructs the same hidden_reference object shape used by the unchanged grader.
authoring_remediation.fresh_attempt_rule: All r3 author attempts are fresh. No r1/r2 rejected hidden payload may be inspected, decoded, repaired, edited, replayed, paraphrased, ranked or reused.
authoring_remediation.safe_observability: Only preregistered structural reason codes, group names, attempt counts, audit reason codes and call counts may be logged; never tagged values, case facts, raw author output or reconstructed hidden reference content.

release_rule: Use the exact r1 FULL release contract after deterministic assembly of the r1 base plus this r3 evaluator-transport remediation. PASS still requires a COMPLETE fresh FULL report, at least 34/36 base tasks, every family at least 2/3, all six repeated critical trials passing and zero critical hard-fails.
